items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I think my first party I played was with Bubba Roberts on trumpet

ctx.x: Well, I got into jazz playing house parties. Yeah. See, they used to have a lot of house parties in Miami, I mean, everybody used to give a party there on a Saturday, and so that was how I got the chance to start playing house parties.
I think my first party I played was with Bubba Roberts on trumpet, his daughter, Gladys played piano, and a guy named, Milton Fletcher -- he was on bass.
